reviews.review_title: Review at La Sen Restaurant & Sky Bar
reviews.review_text:
David B
Munich, Germany1 contribution
0
Very good🤩
May 2025 • Family
The restaurant is friendly and very well maintained. As soon as you enter, you feel welcome. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, ideal for families with children. The family-friendliness is particularly noteworthy – there are child seats and the staff are very patient and understanding of young guests. The staff is extremely friendly, attentive and helpful. Orders are taken quickly and served with a smile. Special requests are also gladly fulfilled. The menu offers a good selection of fresh and delicious dishes, both for meat lovers and vegetarians. Everything is nicely served and tastes great. Prices are reasonable for the quality and service. Overall, it is a place where you feel completely at ease – whether for a cosy dinner for two or a relaxed family outing. We would love to come back
